title: Leexa Fox wins Drag Race México Season 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (MX-S02-E12), the final four — Eva Blunt, Horacio Potasio, Jenary Bloom, and Leexa Fox — lip-synced to Shakira's "Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 53". Leexa Fox was crowned the winner; Eva Blunt, Horacio Potasio, and Jenary Bloom all finished as runners-up.

title: Ignus Ars: Season 2's first Porkchop
summary: Ignus Ars was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race México season 2 (MX-S02-E01), losing "Me río de ti" by Gloria Trevi to Ava Pocket.

title: A tie for Miss Congeniality
summary: At the reunion (MX-S02-E11), fellow contestants voted for two Miss Congenialities: Luna Lansman and Nina de la Fuente. Garçonne was separately named Miss Lost Look for the season's best unaired runway look.
